description: Case-insensitive substring search across labels on a branch. Set in='keys' to match only key names, in='values' to match only translation text, or in='both' (the default) for either. Returns matching labels with their full values, capped at 100 matches. Use this to find keys by a fragment of the key path or by the wording of an existing translation. Reads the token's base branch unless `branch` names another allowed branch.

branch.description: Branch to operate on. Defaults to the token's base (bound) branch. May name any branch in the token's allowed set: its base branch, plus branches this token created (only when the token's scope is create-own; see list_branches). Naming any other branch fails with branch_not_allowed.

in.description: Where to search: key names, translation values, or both (default).

name: search_labels
title: Search Labels
